loading.comment: I like hoisted best, but it looks best in the skeleton lines because of its shape. And it doesnt look good in like the chart plot. So make 5 variations on it
loading.reply: Hoisted is one thin cable and one small load in the middle, which fits the skeleton's thin lines and leaves a wide well (the chart plot, the busy table) mostly empty. Five variations follow it, each checked in every cell: on a gantry (a trolley carries the load along a rail), in relay (three loads, one after the other), as a lintel (one beam as wide as the well), in bays (a hoist for every square of the width) and as a pair (one rises, one is lowered). The progress bar's busy picture no longer sits among the cells; it is the next question.

progress.comment: I don' tlike the progress bar, make 10 variations on that, five should be brand new
progress.reply: A new question, the progress bar, with ten options. Measured, the signature bar is weak in five ways: its stripes are hazard tape, its head covers 18 % of a 122 px track, busy runs on three clocks (600, 1600 and 1200 ms), a share is wiped by a 100 ms clip, and busy and a share are two different textures. Five options keep the bar and fix some of that (solid, ruled, placed, cut loose, labelled); five are brand new, built from the slab (cast, trolley, wall, stairs, level). Each shows busy, 25, 60 and 100 %, and a bar in a card. My pick is cast, a mould on a beam.
